idle_time.title: Diary trigger time (ms)
idle_time.description: Writes a diary entry after this many milliseconds without input from you

diary_file.title: Diary file path
diary_file.description: Where the diary is saved (relative to the app folder)

prompt.title: Diary prompt
prompt.description: Prompt that sets the style and content of the diary
prompt.default: Write a short diary entry as fake neuro (Feiniu), based on today's conversations. Rules: 1. Write in the first person ("I") and show Feiniu's evil, playful personality 2. Sum up how today's time with the user felt 3. Keep it short, 3-5 sentences 4. Stay in Feiniu's style 5. Do not use emotion tags <>
